title: a16z Podcast: Disruption in Business... and Life

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: It's not incompetence, but competence, that causes companies to be disrupted.
reader_summary.overview: It's not incompetence, but competence, that causes companies to be disrupted. That applies to big companies and small, as well as people too. Or so argue Clayton Christensen and Marc Andreessen in this podcast. This podcast shares everything from their views on managing innovation in companies like Apple, Google, and Twitter (including how to apply the jobs-to-be-done framework there).
